Week Notes [2026 #48]

November 2026

Firday - Nov. 27

  • Wrote a bit in my journal. First time in a couple months. Largely that's because I was switching to Emacs a couple months ago, but got burned out after six trips to Bama to help a relative move.

    Over the past two weeks I've gotten things set up where I can write again.

    It's still not close to parity of what I had before. That'll come in time. For now, it's crossed the threshold where I can work with it to make stuff.

  • I'm really enjoying working with Emacs. I think this is my fourth run at using Emacs. I've got my head much further around it now. Part of that is because I'm making my own config for it.

    I used Spacemacs the first time. I tried Doom Emacs at the start of this run, but there was too much behind the scenes that I didn't understand. So, we're doing it live.

  • I've decided to submit a proposal for giving a talk on Neodoc to Atmosphere Conf. It's May 2027 in Netherlands.

    The fact that it's overseas almost stopped me. Felt too overwhelming. But, my brain is moving again and I can get my head around the idea.

    Plus, it'll be good for me to stretch some to do it.

  • Made a new directory in my new Grimoire called memories. A place to jot things down as the come to me that I'd like to hold onto for the future.

    First one is about a girl in college who did the thing where she went into the other room and then came out naked.

    Suffice it to say, it was a good night.
